description: Window cleaning for the gated Villas at Commanders Point, west of Mansfield Dam. About 25 villas, pure water poles, 3,600 sq ft home about $360.
intro: The Villas at Commanders Point is a small gated community of about 25 homes just west of Mansfield Dam, where resales are rare. CleanzATX cleans windows here with pure water, and Tyler Durham quotes each villa himself.

sections.h2: What Villas at Commanders Point homes are like
paragraphs: Roughly 25 villas make up this community, set just west of Mansfield Dam along Mansfield Dam Court. Homes run about 3,600 sq ft and sell for around $760K when one comes up, which does not happen often. A gate controls entry, and the Villas at Commanders Point HOA runs the shared grounds.
Homes this size have a good amount of glass, with big living area windows, upstairs bedrooms and entry panels.

sections.h2: What Villas at Commanders Point windows deal with
paragraphs: The dam and lake are close, so mist and hard water travel on the wind and settle on glass. When it dries, it leaves a haze of white spots, strongest on the south and west sides where sun bakes it on. Sprinkler overspray along landscaped beds does the same thing to lower panes.

The community is also near busy roads and a marina, so dust and road grime add to it. Cedar pollen from December to February and live oak pollen in March and April cover the screens. We clean screens at $5 each and treat mineral spots at $10 per pane.

sections.h2: How we work Villas at Commanders Point
paragraphs: The gate means we need a code or a contact name before the day. Space inside a small community can be tight, so we park where the HOA allows and run the pure water system from the truck. Water fed poles let us reach upper windows up to three stories from the ground, so there are no ladders against stucco or planters. Villas this size work well with a house soft wash in the same trip.
At $0.10 per sq ft, a 3,600 sq ft villa comes to about $360 for the outside of the windows. Expect around three to three and a half hours on site, a bit less if the weather is dry.

faq.q: How do you handle the gate here?
faq.a: Send us the code or a contact name when you request a quote. We confirm the day by text and let ourselves in on arrival.

faq.q: Can several villas be done on the same day?
faq.a: Yes. With only about 25 homes, neighbors often book near each other. Tell us who else is scheduling and we will try to line the visits up.

faq.q: Do you clean the roofs on these villas?
faq.a: Yes. Roof soft wash begins at $0.25 per sq ft with a $400 minimum. We use a low pressure 12V system, and we never use high pressure on a roof.

faq.q: How can I keep the spots from coming back?
faq.a: Regular pure water cleaning stops minerals from building up. Quarterly service is 15% off and includes hard water removal on up to 5 windows per visit, plus the 7 day rain guarantee.

faq.q: Is there a cost to get a quote?
faq.a: No. You text a few photos or the address, and we reply with a quote, usually within the hour during business hours.
